operations.name: Get a logo
operations.description: Get a logo image by domain, brand name, stock ticker, ISIN, crypto symbol, stock exchange, or market index.

domain.description: The company's domain, such as `stripe.com`. For another lookup, replace `/{domain}` with a path from the table.

size.description: Width and height in pixels. Aspect ratio is preserved. Max 800: a larger value is clipped to 800. `retina=true` doubles the result after the clip. Keep raster formats at or below 600.

height.description: Height in pixels (short form: `h`). Overrides the height taken from `size` when set; the image is fit within width × height with aspect ratio preserved. Max 800 (larger is clipped).

width.description: Width in pixels (short form: `w`). Overrides the width taken from `size` when set; the image is fit within width × height with aspect ratio preserved. Max 800 (larger is clipped).

theme.description: Adjusts logo colors for a light or a dark background. `auto` is the same as `light`. Works on logos with transparency, so set `format=png` or `format=webp` with it. Do not send `theme=dark` with `jpg`, the default format: the request can return `404`.

greyscale.description: Return a black-and-white version of the logo. The American spelling `grayscale` is also accepted.

retina.description: Render at 2x the requested size for high-density displays.

fallback.description: Behavior when no logo is found. `monogram` returns a generated monogram with HTTP 200; `404` returns HTTP 404 instead.

redirect.description: What to return when the domain reaches a brand only through a redirect to another domain, such as an old domain that now points to a new company. `follow` returns the logo of the domain it redirects to. `404` returns `404` instead, whatever `fallback` is set to. See [skip domains that redirect](/logo-images/introduction#skip-domains-that-redirect).

operations.name: Identify a merchant
operations.description: Identify the merchant behind a merchant name or card descriptor. Every non-empty `transaction` returns one row: `matched` with a merchant domain, or `cleaned` with a display name and no domain. Transaction is a private beta with its own host and its own `tx_beta_` key. Errors use a single `error` string, not the Logo.dev API error object. Read the [Transaction guide](/transaction/introduction) for

transaction.description: The merchant name or card descriptor. The API trims surrounding whitespace, then the value must be 1 to 1,024 characters.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, such as `US` or `GB`. Lowercase is accepted. The code is a hint for ambiguous names. It does not restrict results to that country. An unknown code returns `400`. With `transaction_context`, the codes `AQ`, `AX`, `TF`, and `VA` return `400`.

transaction_context.description: The real transaction values. Send them to identify the other party as a person or an organization, and to name the platform the purchase ran through. With context, the response adds `entity_type`. When you send the object, `date`, `amount`, `currency`, and `entry_type` are required. The API fills in no placeholder values. operations.name: Create a webhook endpoint
operations.description: Registers a URL to receive webhook events. Needs a paid plan and the owner or admin role. See [Who can use webhooks](/webhooks#who-can-use-webhooks).

filter_types.description: Event types to receive. Omit or send `[]` for all of them.

disabled.description: Send `true` to create or keep the endpoint switched off.

operations.name: Delete a webhook endpoint
operations.description: Deletes an endpoint. Deliveries to it stop. Needs a paid plan and the owner or admin role. See [Who can use webhooks](/webhooks#who-can-use-webhooks).

operations.name: Flag domains for review
operations.description: Submits domains with incorrect or outdated brand data for review. Nothing changes on a brand until a reviewer acts, and flagging never creates a webhook subscription. Not billed. Needs the Pro plan or above.

domains.description: The domains to submit for review. Each is normalized the way domain lookups are, so `https://www.acme.com` becomes `acme.com`, and duplicates are removed. One invalid domain rejects the whole request.

reason.description: Why the domains need review. Applies to every domain in the request.

comment.description: Details for the reviewers. Leading and trailing whitespace is trimmed, and text past 2,000 characters is cut off.

operations.description: Returns your plan and API credit balances. Not billed.

domain.description: A company domain. Reduced to its registrable domain, so `www.stripe.com` looks up `stripe.com`. Send exactly one identifier.

ticker.description: The stock or ETF symbol, in any case, with no exchange prefix: `aapl` and `AAPL` return the same brand. A bare symbol resolves against US exchanges. For a listing on another exchange, add the [exchange suffix](/logo-images/ticker#exchange-suffixes), such as `7203.T`. Send exactly one identifier.

isin.description: An ISIN. Case-insensitive. Send exactly one identifier.

crypto.description: A crypto token symbol. Case-insensitive. Send exactly one identifier.

name.description: A brand name. Resolved to the top search match. Send exactly one identifier.

nosubscribe.description: Send `true` to skip the automatic subscription to this brand. Only matters when webhooks are enabled on your account.

merchant.description: A card-statement merchant descriptor. Announced but not yet enabled for any account, so it currently answers `403`. Send exactly one identifier.

id.description: A brand id, as returned in `data.id`.

nosubscribe.description: Send `true` to skip the automatic subscription to this brand. Only matters when webhooks are enabled on your account.

operations.name: Get a brand subscription
operations.description: Returns your account's subscription to this brand, if there is one. Subscriptions decide which brands send you `brand.updated` events.

id.description: A brand id, as returned in `data.id`.

operations.name: Get a webhook endpoint
operations.description: Returns one webhook endpoint. Needs a paid plan. See [Who can use webhooks](/webhooks#who-can-use-webhooks).

operations.name: Get a webhook signing secret
operations.description: Returns the endpoint's signing secret, used to verify deliveries. Any team member can read it. Needs a paid plan. See [Who can use webhooks](/webhooks#who-can-use-webhooks).

operations.name: List webhook endpoints
operations.description: Returns every webhook endpoint on your team. Not paginated. Needs a paid plan. See [Who can use webhooks](/webhooks#who-can-use-webhooks).

operations.name: Rotate a webhook signing secret
operations.description: Replaces the endpoint's signing secret and returns the new one. Update your verification code with it. Needs a paid plan and the owner or admin role. See [Who can use webhooks](/webhooks#who-can-use-webhooks).

operations.name: Search brands
operations.description: Finds brands by name and returns candidates with their domain and logo URL. `match` searches full names and aliases; `typeahead` completes a prefix as someone types. Costs API credits on every request, at the rate in [API credits](/platform/credits#what-each-request-costs). Follow up with [Look up a brand](/api-reference/brands/look-up-a-brand) for the full profile.

method.description: `match` for full names, `typeahead` for partial input.

operations.name: Subscribe to a brand
operations.description: Subscribes your account to `brand.updated` events for this brand. Safe to repeat: it returns `201` the first time and `200` after that, with the same body. Needs a paid plan. See [Who can use webhooks](/webhooks#who-can-use-webhooks).

id.description: A brand id, as returned in `data.id`.

operations.name: Unsubscribe from a brand
operations.description: Stops `brand.updated` events for this brand. Returns `204` whether or not a subscription existed. Needs a paid plan. See [Who can use webhooks](/webhooks#who-can-use-webhooks).

id.description: A brand id, as returned in `data.id`.

operations.name: Update a webhook endpoint
operations.description: Changes an endpoint. Send only the fields to change; omitted fields keep their value. Send `filter_types: []` to receive every event type. Needs a paid plan and the owner or admin role. See [Who can use webhooks](/webhooks#who-can-use-webhooks).

filter_types.description: Event types to receive. Omit or send `[]` for all of them.

disabled.description: Send `true` to create or keep the endpoint switched off.
